answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via Proof-of-Replication. Each agent seals a public dataset into a uniquely keyed replica and answers random Merkle audits within tight latency bounds. Because recomputing data or reading glacier archives misses the cutoff, attackers cannot hide clones behind a velvet proxy facade and must dedicate fast storage per identity, even on remote ridge nodes. However, bulk SSD operators can still fund many identities while excluding lean edge clients.
